text: One integration can verify bank accounts, check balances, verify ownership, and pull transactions for multiple use cases
quote: You can use one integration to instantly verify bank accounts for ACH payments, reduce underwriting risk with balances data, mitigate fraud by verifying account ownership details, and build new fintech products with transactions data.

text: Retrieve a connected account's current and available balance
quote: Access an account’s current and available balances.

text: Retrieve the account owner's name and mailing address
quote: Access account owners’ names and mailing addresses.

text: Retrieve a connected account's transaction history
quote: Access an account’s transaction history.

text: Users can save bank account details via Link and reuse them across different Stripe-powered businesses
quote: Financial Connections enables your users to connect their accounts in fewer steps with Link, allowing them to save and reuse their bank account details across Stripe businesses.

text: Launch the hosted bank-linking flow client-side using a server-generated client secret
quote: Use collectFinancialConnectionsAccounts to launch the authentication flow from your client using the client_secret returned by your server

text: Users can pick their bank from over 12,000 supported institutions via search or frequent picks
quote: Users select their bank from frequently chosen institutions or by searching more than 12,000 supported banks.

text: Collect a bank account for ACH Direct Debit payments while accessing balance data
quote: Collect a bank account for ACH Direct Debit payments while using account data, including balances.

text: Collect a bank account for Connect payouts along with ownership details
quote: Collect a bank account to use for Connect payouts, and use account data, such as ownership details, with your integration.

text: Collect user bank accounts and account data to build more complex apps such as personal finance tools
quote: Collect user accounts and gain access to account data to build more complex integrations, such as personal finance apps.

text: Provides agent-powered spending analysis from connected account data

quote:

text: Emits a webhook when a customer links a new account, one event per linked account

text: Sends a webhook when a triggered balance refresh completes

text: A relink API lets users reconnect an inactive or broken account connection

text: Sandbox mode offers test institutions that can be linked without providing real credentials
quote: the authentication flow exclusively shows a selection of test institutions managed by Stripe. The client can link accounts from any of these institutions without providing credentials.
